surviving_claim: The file is not retracted and no measurement in it fails. Its 6 digest occurrence(s) name the panel the run executed against, which is a true historical fact and the reason this arm is comparable to the others. What is void is reading them as the current panel: ee1362df3f09 is a new freeze, so these fields no longer identify the panel in the tree. No quality verdict in this file recomputes against a rewritten cell, so the void is the same one every other marker in this finding carries and stops at the digest.
note: artifact_sha256 is the git blob digest, so the marker binds to the committed bytes rather than to one host line-ending policy; on a core.autocrlf checkout sha256_file sees CRLF and reports this marker stale, which is the checkout rather than the artifact. This is a run export, not a use-record file: it carries no per-cell verdict on a rewritten within-graph cell, which is why its void_scope stops at the digest pointers.
